summary: Melba School District opposes narrowing or sunset of E‑Rate, urges preservation of rural funding and cautions against tying eligibility to NSLP or single‑provider status; it also calls for screen‑time conditions to be content‑based. The commenter urges the FCC to keep E‑Rate active, preserve rural access, and condition any screen‑time rules on content and instructional design rather than blanket hour limits.
